points.point: Why the carousel with a collaborator fails
points.sentence: They are not supported on carousels, and a carousel with collaborators fails to publish.

points.point: Single photo posts with a collaborator work
points.sentence: Collaborators are supported on single image posts and reels.

points.point: What to do for a carousel
points.sentence: For a carousel, publish it first, then add the collaborator in the Instagram app.

verdict.reason: The entry says Instagram collaborators are not supported on carousels, so those posts fail. It also says single image posts are supported, which matches what the customer sees.
